description: An open red leather case on a table, filled with gold and silver coins, with a few spilling out. Behind it, an old woman in a ragged dark shawl and an old man in a flat cap lean in, one reaching toward the coins. Blank papers and a closed leather ledger lie on the table. Through a window at right, a grey dreadnought-style battleship with several gun turrets and tall masts sails on rough sea under smoky sky. Dark, painterly oil style, no visible text.
